# OGIMORA

> Free online generator of steel fire pits. You design a fire pit in the browser and download a DXF file ready for CNC laser or plasma cutting. Test version, made by one person (OGI).

- What it does: set the base size, height, wall angle and sheet thickness (3, 4 or 5 mm); choose a cut-out pattern for each of the four walls; add your own lettering; choose holes in the floor. Parts (4 walls + floor) join with tabs and slots.
- Downloads: DXF in millimetres at 1:1 scale; an A4 paper model (PDF); test plates (DXF + PDF instructions) for finding the right slot clearance on a given laser or plasma machine.
- Price: free. The site shows a rough cutting-cost estimate for Poland (PLN) and the USA (USD).
- Licence: free for personal use; commercial use up to 20 finished fire pits per design; the files themselves may not be sold or passed on.
- Warranty: none. Files are generated by a script and should be checked before cutting. A fire pit means open fire; cut-out patterns let sparks through.
- Languages: English (https://ogimora.com/en/) and Polish (https://ogimora.com/pl/).
- Units: millimetres. Inch dimensions are planned.
- Privacy: no cookies, no accounts; anonymous counters only.
- Contact: info@ogimora.com
